FIELDS.NAME: Handyman's Haven
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Home Improvement Ave, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-5678
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Handyman's Haven operates as a retail hardware and home improvement store, offering a wide range of products including tools, fasteners, paint, and gardening supplies. Our operations emphasize customer engagement through in-store workshops and product demonstrations, adhering to strict safety protocols to ensure a safe shopping environment. We maintain robust employee training programs and comply with OSHA standards, which helps mitigate workplace injury risks. Our inventory management system is designed to enhance stock accuracy and reduce shrinkage, while our established vendor relationships provide a reliable supply chain. We are committed to environmental compliance regarding any hazardous materials, ensuring they are stored and labeled correctly. Our physical store location allows us to serve the community effectively, providing essential home improvement solutions while minimizing risks associated with theft and loss.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Handyman's Haven operates a small local tool rental service under the name "Tool Time Rentals," which provides tools and equipment to contractors and DIY enthusiasts in the Springfield area.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to theft of outdoor inventory over several incidents, totaling $20,000 between April 12, 2022, and June 15, 2023. Additionally, weather-related damage to stored lumber resulted in $5,000 in losses in January 2023. Ongoing efforts to enhance security measures are in place to mitigate future risks.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Sunday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade, UL listed burglary safe; Class B, Group 1, with a 1-hour fire rating.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with perimeter fencing and regular security patrols.
